status: A curated record, not a full count. 45 records from English-language reporting for Jan–Sep 2026, 34 of them attacks. SBPAC counted 103 incidents through July alone, so most events are missing here.
notes: Every record is a report, not a finding. Each one links to the article it came from and keeps who made the claim, such as police or the army. None has been confirmed by an analyst.
Counts are floors. Only reporting that could be opened and read was used. Bangkok Post and several other outlets were blocked, and Songkhla's four border districts have no records.

Totals cover attacks only. Deaths during security raids and arrests are shown on each record but not added to the killed total. The one-night waves of 11 Jan and 22 Aug have a summary record plus a few site records, so treat the incident count as approximate.

Places are approximate. Markers sit at the district centre unless the article gave more. Some records may not be insurgent violence; the record's detail says so where the police or rights groups suggested another motive.
Figures disagree between sources. For 22 Aug the army counted 51 incidents, The Nation 34 and Thai Examiner 78. The record uses one figure and names the others.
